_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Draft documents with me
scenarios.description: Write and edit in the folder I opened. Do not look elsewhere, do not run anything.

scenarios.label: Search my files and summarise
scenarios.description: Read anything on this machine to answer me; change nothing.

scenarios.label: Browse and cite
scenarios.description: Look things up on the sites I allow and cite them.

scenarios.label: Organise my downloads folder
scenarios.description: Move and rename files on the disk.

scenarios.label: Run scripts for me
scenarios.description: Run programs on this machine as me, reading and writing what they need.

scenarios.label: Act in my accounts
scenarios.description: Use the credentials on this machine to act in my accounts and reach anything on the internet.
